Forward the signed application along with self-attested copies of certificates and documents in proof of age, educational qualifications, experience, and other relevant supporting documents to The Registrar, Sreenarayanaguru Open University, Kollam, 691601 so as to reach on or before 18 November 2026.
important_instructions: The appointment shall be purely on a contract basis and shall not confer any claim for regular appointment or absorption in the University. Candidates should possess the prescribed qualifications and experience as on the last date fixed for the submission of applications. Original certificates relating to age, educational qualifications, experience and other relevant documents shall be produced for verification as and when required by the University. Mere submission of an application does not confer any right to be called for a test/interview or selection. The University reserves the right to shortlist candidates based on qualifications, experience and other criteria. Canvassing in any form shall lead to disqualification. Incomplete applications and applications received after the last date for submission will be summarily rejected. The decision of the University in all matters relating to the selection process shall be final and binding.

faq.question: Q1. What is SGOU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: SGOU Recruitment 2026 is an official notification released by Sreenarayanaguru Open University, Kollam to hire 10 personnel for Software Developer, Software Tester, Network Engineer, Operational Support Team Leader, and Operational Support Engineer posts on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under SGOU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 10 vacancies available across 5 distinct post categories.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for SGOU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications is 11 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the printed application by post?
faq.answer: The hard copy of the application along with self-attested supporting documents must reach the University office on or before 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for SGOU Software Developer posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a regular B.Tech./B.E. in Computer Science & Engineering/Information Technology, MCA, or M.Sc. Computer Science, along with a minimum of one year of professional experience in software development.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Operational Support Team Leader post?
faq.answer: The Operational Support Team Leader receives a consolidated contract pay of ₹50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for SGOU contract posts?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 40 years with usual relaxation to SC, ST, and OBC communities.

faq.question: Q8. Where should candidates send the printed application form?
faq.answer: Printed applications must be sent to The Registrar, Sreenarayanaguru Open University, Kollam, 691601.
